description: This file defines FastAPI routes for the Connector Backend API, including authentication endpoints, connector management, business operations like search and creation, project and space listing, and an LLM proxy. It also contains relevant data schemas, helper functions, and inline comments explaining various aspects of the API.

classes.name: ApiKeyShimRequest
classes.description: Schema for API key override requests, includes optional connector key and user ID fields.

classes.name: ApiKeyAuthRequest
classes.description: Payload schema for storing/validating API keys with connector and user details.

classes.name: OAuthStartRequest
classes.description: Schema to initiate OAuth flow, includes connector key, user ID, optional state and scopes.

classes.name: OAuthStartResponse
classes.description: Response schema containing the OAuth authorization URL.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackRequest
classes.description: Schema for handling OAuth callback, with connector key, user ID, code, and optional state.

classes.name: SearchRequest
classes.description: Schema for search parameters including connector, user, query, filters, and limit.

classes.name: SearchItem
classes.description: Schema representing an individual search result item.

classes.name: CreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating new items in providers, includes target connector, user, and payload.

classes.name: CreateResponse
classes.description: Schema for responses after creating an item, includes ID, URL, and metadata.

classes.name: ProjectsResponse
classes.description: Schema for listing projects associated with connectors.

classes.name: SpacesResponse
classes.description: Schema for listing spaces associated with connectors.

classes.name: ConnectorUpsertRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating or updating connector configurations.

classes.name: ConnectorResponse
classes.description: Schema for representing connector info to API consumers.

methods.name: ConnectorResponse connector_to_response(c: Connector)
methods.description: Helper to convert Connector model instances to response schema

methods.name: auth_api_key( body: ApiKeyAuthRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Endpoint to validate and store API keys for connectors

methods.name: auth_oauth_start(body: OAuthStartRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Endpoint to initiate OAuth flow and retrieve authorization URL

methods.name: auth_oauth_callback(body: OAuthCallbackRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Handle OAuth callback, exchange codes, and store tokens

methods.name: list_connectors(ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Retrieve list of registered connectors for the tenant

methods.name: upsert_connector( key: str, body: ConnectorUpsertRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Create or update connector configuration for the tenant

methods.name: search( body: SearchRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: Perform search across provider with retries and rate limiting

methods.name: create( body: CreateRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: Create an item in provider with retries and rate limiting

methods.name: list_projects( connector_key: str, user_id: str, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: List projects from a connector that supports project listing

methods.name: list_spaces( connector_key: str, user_id: str, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: List spaces from a connector that supports spaces

methods.name: llm_proxy(request: Request, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Proxy requests to configured LLM service with retries

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase _get_service_for_op( connector_key: str, ctx: TenantContext, token_repo: UserTokenRepo )
methods.description: Helper to obtain provider service instance for a given connector
